headline: Nifty Pharma index hits record high led by Sun, Laurus, Zydus, and Sai
hook: New peak for the Nifty Pharma index
summary: The Nifty Pharma index reached a record high in Friday's trade, driven by rallies of up to 6 percent in stocks such as Sun Pharma, Laurus Labs, Zydus Lifesciences, and Sai Lifesciences. Other major pharmaceutical companies including Mankind Pharma, Ipca Laboratories, Torrent Pharmaceuticals, Divis Laboratories, Cipla, and Aurobindo Pharma also gained around 2 percent each. Indian retail investors with exposure to healthcare and pharmaceutical mutual funds or index stocks see direct valuation gains from this sector-wide momentum.
why_it_matters: Pharma portfolio gains rise as sector index hits new high
winners_losers: Pharma investors gain / no clear losers
